title: Super-enhancers mediates SLC7A11 via FOXA1 to regulate disulfidptosis in prostate cancer.
authors: Kang, Zhen; Lin, Bin; Ke, Zhi-Bin; Zheng, Qing-Shui; Xue, Xue-Yi; Wei, Yong; Xu, Ning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究前列腺癌中超级增强子经FOXA1调控SLC7A11影响二硫化物死亡，虽涉及FOXA1-DNA结合但以湿实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Prostate cancer (PCa) remains a major therapeutic challenge due to aberrant androgen receptor signaling and a remodeled tumor microenvironment. Disulfidptosis, a recently identified form of cell death characterized by cytoskeletal collapse under conditions of glucose deprivation and elevated SLC7A11 expression, presents a potential novel avenue for intervention. In this study, we integrated TCGA and GEO data and employed machine learning techniques to identify disulfidptosis-related genes in prostate cancer. Functional analyses using SLC7A11-overexpressing and knockout cell lines demonstrated that SLC7A11 promotes cellular proliferation, migration, and invasion, while its overexpression under glucose-starved conditions triggers disulfidptosis, also inducible pharmacologically using the glucose uptake inhibitor BAY-876. Through CUT&Tag, ChIP-seq, and luciferase assays, we identified FOXA1 as a key transcriptional regulator of SLC7A11, driven by a super-enhancer located at chr14:37583488-37589585. CRISPR-Cas9 deletion of this super-enhancer reduced FOXA1 and SLC7A11 expression, thereby protecting cells from disulfidptosis. These findings highlight the critical role of the SE/FOXA1/SLC7A11 regulatory axis in driving both disulfidptosis and tumor progression, suggesting that targeting this pathway, particularly in glucose-deprived tumor environments, may offer promising therapeutic strategies for PCa.
abstract_zh: 前列腺癌（PCa）由于异常的雄激素受体信号传导和重塑的肿瘤微环境，仍然是一个重大的治疗挑战。双硫死亡（disulfidptosis）是一种新近发现的细胞死亡形式，其特征是在葡萄糖剥夺和SLC7A11表达升高的条件下细胞骨架塌陷，为干预提供了潜在的新途径。在本研究中，我们整合了TCGA和GEO数据，并采用机器学习技术来识别前列腺癌中与双硫死亡相关的基因。使用SLC7A11过表达和敲除细胞系的功能分析表明，SLC7A11促进细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，而其过表达在葡萄糖饥饿条件下触发双硫死亡，也可通过葡萄糖摄取抑制剂BAY-876在药理学上诱导。通过CUT&Tag、ChIP-seq和荧光素酶实验，我们确定FOXA1是SLC7A11的关键转录调控因子，由位于chr14:37583488-37589585的超增强子驱动。CRISPR-Cas9删除该超增强子降低了FOXA1和SLC7A11的表达，从而保护细胞免受双硫死亡。这些发现强调了SE/FOXA1/SLC7A11调控轴在驱动双硫死亡和肿瘤进展中的关键作用，提示靶向该通路，特别是在葡萄糖剥夺的肿瘤环境中，可能为PCa提供有前景的治疗策略。
